question: What charge and input-current headroom must the independent logic input protection allow?
scope: Zero initial charge, initial capacitance envelope only, ideal LDO current transfer excluding ground current.
stop: Charge, energy and one reference ramp only; no invented regulator waveform, current-limit or startup-time pass.
criterion: A bounded current source must supply net capacitor charge in addition to load; continuous rating alone does not prove startup.
